excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared secondary entities and structures in the background, separate from primary subjects and whole-place state.

body_pose.description: Explicit whole-body posture, support or articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body, without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
body_pose.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸의 명시적 전신 자세·지지·관절 배치. 실제 대상과 몸의 범위를 확인하며 언급하지 않은 신체 부위나 지지 접촉을 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: A rigid object shape, a camera viewpoint or an activity word alone does not establish a whole-body pose.
Relative rotation of body axes, hand articulation, concrete action and rendered motion have separate roles when supported.
Do not turn an unavailable body or limb into a new entity to satisfy a pose.
includes: Explicit standing, sitting, lying or other whole-body posture of a declared human, animal, robot or represented body.
Preserve the actual support and articulated connections when declared. Standing alone does not supply feet, legs, a supporting ground contact or a human body.
Decide effect versus a required existing posture from the whole source; source-specific category and domain conditions remain cumulative.

body_region.description: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.
body_region.description_ko: 선택된 신체 부위와 관찰 범위: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
excludes: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
includes: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.

camera_direction.description: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.
camera_direction.description_ko: 카메라 관측 방향과 대상 대비 각도: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
excludes: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
includes: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.

camera_distance.description: Physical camera-to-subject distance or declared observer separation, independent of shot scale and lens choice.
camera_distance.description_ko: 카메라 거리: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Physical camera-to-subject distance or declared observer separation, independent of shot scale and lens choice.

camera_height.description: Camera height relative to a declared reference, distinct from viewing axis and distance.
camera_height.description_ko: 지정 기준면·대상 대비 카메라 높이: 카메라 기울기·관찰자 사회적 역할과 구별; 높이만으로 광학을 확정하지 않음
excludes: 카메라 기울기·관찰자 사회적 역할과 구별; 높이만으로 광학을 확정하지 않음
includes: Camera height relative to a declared reference, distinct from viewing axis and distance.

camera_movement.description: Declared camera movement or support stability during capture, separate from subject movement and its recorded blur.
camera_movement.description_ko: 카메라 움직임: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared camera movement or support stability during capture, separate from subject movement and its recorded blur.

camera_type.description: Declared acquisition device class, distinct from its mounting and from the image's imitation of a device look.
camera_type.description_ko: 선택된 촬영 장치와 영상 취득 계열: 카메라 외관·장착 방식·매체 표현을 분리; 장치가 픽셀에 보이는지 별도 판정
excludes: 카메라 외관·장착 방식·매체 표현을 분리; 장치가 픽셀에 보이는지 별도 판정
includes: Declared acquisition device class, distinct from its mounting and from the image's imitation of a device look.

capture_configuration.description: Arrangement of camera, operator, support, subject and reflecting surfaces during capture.
capture_configuration.description_ko: 운용자·지지·장치·반사면의 촬영 구성: 셀피 세부만으로 한정하지 않음; core의 camera.capture_mode 필드와 슬롯 ID를 구별
excludes: 셀피 세부만으로 한정하지 않음; core의 camera.capture_mode 필드와 슬롯 ID를 구별
includes: Arrangement of camera, operator, support, subject and reflecting surfaces during capture.

capture_context.description: Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.
capture_context.description_ko: 촬영 목적·기록 상황·접근과 관찰 조건: 장치 배치와 물리 촬영 구성은 capture_configuration; 기록 경위는 픽셀 사실이 아님
excludes: 장치 배치와 물리 촬영 구성은 capture_configuration; 기록 경위는 픽셀 사실이 아님
includes: Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.

character_intent.description: Explicit character goal or intended response used as narrative context, not a proven private mental state.
character_intent.description_ko: 명시된 인물의 목표와 반응 맥락: mid-handoff·공개 직전은 narrative_phase; 정체성 추론 금지는 정책이며 의도 후보가 아님
excludes: mid-handoff·공개 직전은 narrative_phase; 정체성 추론 금지는 정책이며 의도 후보가 아님
includes: Explicit character goal or intended response used as narrative context, not a proven private mental state.

color.description: Owned local colors and bounded color arrangements, separate from whole-image grading.
color.description_ko: 지정 대상·영역의 색과 색 배치: 전역 색 보정·HDR과 구별; 배경 색을 주체 색으로 바꾸지 않음
excludes: 전역 색 보정·HDR과 구별; 배경 색을 주체 색으로 바꾸지 않음
includes: Owned local colors and bounded color arrangements, separate from whole-image grading.

color_grading.description: Image-wide or specified tonal-band color and tone transformations, preserving locked local colors.
color_grading.description_ko: 이미지 전체 또는 지정 톤 대역의 색·톤 변환: 대상의 실제 고유색과 구별; 잠긴 영역 색을 덮어쓰지 않음
excludes: 대상의 실제 고유색과 구별; 잠긴 영역 색을 덮어쓰지 않음
includes: Image-wide or specified tonal-band color and tone transformations, preserving locked local colors.

companion_animal.description: A separately declared animal participant explicitly accompanying an identified primary subject, with the companion relation, count and ownership grounded.
companion_animal.description_ko: 명시된 주 대상에 실제로 동반하는 별도 동물 참여자. 주 대상과 동물의 동반 관계·수·소유자를 각각 확인하며 주 대상을 인간으로 한정하지 않는다.
excludes: A lone animal, an animal name, another animal in the background or a generic peaceful mood alone does not establish companionship.
Do not infer pet ownership, species, domestication, affection, physical contact or a new primary subject from the tag.
An animal-only source with no accompanying relation must use its actual subject/action roles instead.
includes: An explicit animal companion relation to the declared primary subject; the primary subject can be human or nonhuman.
Keep animal identity/count, independent owners and any required contact or placement conditions exactly as supported.

concept_tension.description: A declared conceptual contrast embodied by identifiable owners or states, not an unsupported abstract label.
concept_tension.description_ko: 함께 나타난 개념·상태 간 의미 대비: 한 인물의 반응 대비와 구별; 추상 대비에 실제 소유자·표현 근거 필요
excludes: 한 인물의 반응 대비와 구별; 추상 대비에 실제 소유자·표현 근거 필요
includes: A declared conceptual contrast embodied by identifiable owners or states, not an unsupported abstract label.

contact_point.description: Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.
contact_point.description_ko: 연결된 소유자·신체 부위·물건의 접촉 관계: 행동명과 구별; 지지·가림·압력 표현은 실제 연결과 상태 근거 필요
excludes: 행동명과 구별; 지지·가림·압력 표현은 실제 연결과 상태 근거 필요
includes: Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.

declared_person_background.description: Explicitly declared personal origin or background used as context, never inferred from appearance.
declared_person_background.description_ko: 명시된 인물 배경 맥락: 국가 출신은 외모로 확인할 수 없음; 얼굴 특징·국적을 서로 추론하지 않음
excludes: 국가 출신은 외모로 확인할 수 없음; 얼굴 특징·국적을 서로 추론하지 않음
includes: Explicitly declared personal origin or background used as context, never inferred from appearance.

depth_of_field.description: Depth extent of acceptable sharpness and background or foreground blur, separate from focus-plane selection.
depth_of_field.description_ko: 심도: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Depth extent of acceptable sharpness and background or foreground blur, separate from focus-plane selection.

environment_detail.description: Local wear, utilities and use traces owned by environmental surfaces or fixtures.
environment_detail.description_ko: 환경의 국소 세부: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Local wear, utilities and use traces owned by environmental surfaces or fixtures.

exposure.description: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.
exposure.description_ko: 기록 노출과 톤 범위: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.

expression.description: Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Includes expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks; not a proven private emotion, consciousness or hidden muscle action. Artificial and represented responses remain on their declared carriers.
expression.description_ko: 선언된 사람·동물의 관찰 가능한 얼굴·눈 주위 반응, 또는 명시된 인공 얼굴·얼굴 표현물에 실제로 드러난 표정 반응. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 표정성 눈썹 위치를 포함한다. 인공·묘사된 반응은 선언된 물체·표현물의 소유 범위에 머물며, 사적인 감정·의식·숨은 근육 작동이나 시선 방향·목표·눈맞춤을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 시선 목표와 사적인 마음 상태를 표정 사실로 취급하지 않음
Eye or iris direction, a named gaze target or camera/participant engagement alone; these properties require their own evidence and roles.
Consciousness, absence of mind, actual emotion, personality, intention, successful perception or hidden muscle operation inferred from an expression, including empty-looking machine gaze.
Face shape or proportions, sensor/optical-iris hardware, material, skin finish, grooming or cosmetic line alone without a positively declared facial response.

An artificial or represented facial response does not imply living skin, biological eyes or eyelids, newly added facial parts, a living carrier or an additional human/animal. Preserve the actual artificial or representation owner; do not convert it to biological anatomy.

Metadata, old slot names/effects, an optional member/profile, or an actor/object/representation owner label alone cannot supply a face, facial response or unconditional application scope. Intrinsic source conditions and independently frozen binding conditions remain conjunctive and unchanged.
includes: Observable facial or eye-area response of one declared human or animal, including expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks, without proving private emotion.

An explicitly declared artificial face presenting an empty-looking machine gaze or a too-precisely held social expression. The source must positively describe the visible facial response; robot identity or sensor hardware alone is insufficient.

A visible expression explicitly described on one declared face representation remains owned by that representation and its carrier. It neither creates a living actor nor transfers a depicted response to another subject. A generic facial resemblance or ornament label alone is insufficient.

facial_geometry.description: Owned facial shape, local anatomical geometry and proportions, separate from cosmetic contour or skin finish.
facial_geometry.description_ko: 얼굴 윤곽·부위 형태·비례: 모든 후보가 둘의 관계는 아님; 피부 마감·화장 명암과 실제 형상 구별
excludes: 모든 후보가 둘의 관계는 아님; 피부 마감·화장 명암과 실제 형상 구별
includes: Owned facial shape, local anatomical geometry and proportions, separate from cosmetic contour or skin finish.

film_emulation.description: A coherent visual emulation of a named film or photographic medium, without claiming the medium was actually used.
film_emulation.description_ko: 선택한 필름 계열의 복합 영상 표현: 입자 하나는 grain_profile; 실제 필름 사용 여부와 모사 외관을 구별
excludes: 입자 하나는 grain_profile; 실제 필름 사용 여부와 모사 외관을 구별
includes: A coherent visual emulation of a named film or photographic medium, without claiming the medium was actually used.

focus.description: Placement and priority of the focus plane and relative sharpness of named planes.
focus.description_ko: 선명도 우선순위와 초점면 관계: 시선 목표·감각적 주목과 구별; 두 깊이 평면의 상대 선명도 명시
excludes: 시선 목표·감각적 주목과 구별; 두 깊이 평면의 상대 선명도 명시
includes: Placement and priority of the focus plane and relative sharpness of named planes.

format.description: Image aspect ratio and output or display container, distinct from crop-safe composition and media appearance.
format.description_ko: 이미지 비율과 물리·출력 형식: UI-safe 영역은 platform_framing; VHS 외관은 매체 표현
excludes: UI-safe 영역은 platform_framing; VHS 외관은 매체 표현
includes: Image aspect ratio and output or display container, distinct from crop-safe composition and media appearance.

garment_state.description: Current garment wear, fastening, wetness or deformation, separate from construction and body state.
garment_state.description_ko: 의복의 현재 상태: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Current garment wear, fastening, wetness or deformation, separate from construction and body state.

gaze_engagement.description: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.
gaze_engagement.description_ko: 카메라·다른 참여자와 맺는 시선 관계: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
excludes: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
includes: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.

gaze_target.description: Target of the declared actor's gaze, with head orientation and eye state treated separately.
gaze_target.description_ko: 지정 눈·머리의 관찰 목표: 시선 방향·대상 위치·눈 감음을 구별; 몸 방향은 별도 소유 속성
excludes: 시선 방향·대상 위치·눈 감음을 구별; 몸 방향은 별도 소유 속성
includes: Target of the declared actor's gaze, with head orientation and eye state treated separately.

genre.description: Photographic genre and the conventions of the work, distinct from equipment and world rules.
genre.description_ko: 사진 작업의 장르와 표현 관습: 매체·세계 규칙·개별 촬영 장치와 구별; 현재 여러 분류가 섞임
excludes: 매체·세계 규칙·개별 촬영 장치와 구별; 현재 여러 분류가 섞임
includes: Photographic genre and the conventions of the work, distinct from equipment and world rules.

grain_profile.description: Grain or stochastic noise distribution on the image plane, not physical material grain or airborne dust.
grain_profile.description_ko: 이미지 면의 입자와 노이즈 분포: 표면 질감·공기 먼지·렌즈 먼지와 구별
excludes: 표면 질감·공기 먼지·렌즈 먼지와 구별
includes: Grain or stochastic noise distribution on the image plane, not physical material grain or airborne dust.

hair_style.description: Explicit shape, length, arrangement or strand topology of an identified hair region or wig, separate from its color and material identity.
hair_style.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역이나 가발의 명시적 형태·길이·배치·가닥 연결. 색·재질과 분리하며 자연 모발·가발·묘사된 머리의 실제 소유자를 구별한다.
excludes: A synthetic fiber sheen alone does not supply a hairstyle or a living hair root.
General animal fur, a braided rope, a body-hair region and a hair-color word are not automatically a head-hair arrangement.
Do not introduce a wearer, head, scalp, follicles, hair identity or a new physical strand connection from a style name.
includes: An explicitly declared hair or wig arrangement with its actual owned region and strand continuity.
A standalone wig or represented hair can qualify without inventing a human wearer or biological follicles.
Source-specific wearer/category conditions and existing-region prerequisites remain mandatory.

hand_pose.description: Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.
hand_pose.description_ko: 소유 손의 정적 형태와 연결: 물건 사용 동작·손 접촉과 구별; 실제로 둘을 표현하면 다중 역할 허용
excludes: 물건 사용 동작·손 접촉과 구별; 실제로 둘을 표현하면 다중 역할 허용
includes: Static shape and articulation of owned hands and fingers, with support and contact represented separately.

historical_period.description: Explicit historical or future period as scene context, separate from nostalgic color grading.

includes: Recorded detail, acuity and edge rendering, distinct from physical realism claims and focus-plane placement.

excludes: 초점거리 효과와 장치 정체를 혼동하지 않음; 초점면은 focus
includes: Declared lens optics and projection characteristics, distinct from camera distance and chosen focus planes.

lens_artifact.description: Image effects arising along the optical path, distinct from physical scene particles and encoding damage.
lens_artifact.description_ko: 광학 경로와 이미지 면에 생긴 영상 흔적: 환경 속 입자 자체와 구별; 긴 노출·광학 flare·매체 압축의 분리 범위 검토

light_color.description: Color or color-temperature relation of declared illumination and its receivers, separate from local pigment or grading.
light_color.description_ko: 빛의 색: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Color or color-temperature relation of declared illumination and its receivers, separate from local pigment or grading.

light_direction.description: Incident light direction relative to a declared receiver and coordinate frame.
light_direction.description_ko: 지정 대상과 기준축에 대한 입사 방향: 카메라 방향·빛무늬와 구별; 배우 기준과 화면 기준 명시

light_intensity.description: Level of illumination reaching a declared receiver, distinct from recorded exposure and tone mapping.
light_intensity.description_ko: 대상에 도달하는 빛의 수준과 대비: 노출·톤 보존·클리핑·bloom이 섞임; image tone·optical artifact와 구별

includes: Level of illumination reaching a declared receiver, distinct from recorded exposure and tone mapping.

light_quality.description: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.
light_quality.description_ko: 빛의 경계와 광질: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.

A source device name or ambiguous named lighting look alone does not establish softness, angular extent or shadow transition.
includes: Illumination softness, angular extent and resulting shadow transition, separate from intensity and image exposure.

light_shape.description: Explicit spatial geometry of illumination, highlights or shadow boundaries on an identified receiving surface or within a declared illuminated spatial region.
light_shape.description_ko: 특정 수광 표면 또는 명시된 공간 영역에 나타나는 빛·하이라이트·그림자 경계의 공간 형태. 표면 무늬와 명시적 입체 광선 분포를 실제 범위에 맞게 구별한다.
excludes: A ray shape does not itself identify a lamp, camera, fog, smoke, dust particles or the physical scattering mechanism.
Spatial shape alone does not supply incident direction, light intensity, color temperature or the type of source.
Sacred/revelatory wording does not create a deity, religious event or an otherwise unmentioned world fact.
includes: A source-declared light pattern or shadow boundary on its actual receiving surface.
Explicit volumetric rays or other spatial light geometry can use their declared spatial region; a physical receiving surface is not compulsory for that meaning.
Preserve the source geometry, carrier and actual light/receiver relation. The source may require additional independently grounded owners.

light_type.description: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.
light_type.description_ko: 광원의 종류와 발생 방식: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
excludes: 긴 노출 궤적은 motion_rendering 계열; 광원 정체와 영상 흔적 구별
A named day phase or lighting look alone does not identify a source type or emission mechanism.
includes: Light-source type and emission mechanism, distinct from exposure trails and image artifacts.

lighting.description: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.
lighting.description_ko: 소유자·배치·광질이 연결된 조명 구성: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
excludes: 단일 광원 종류와 여러 속성의 완결된 구성을 구별; 하위 속성 자동 태깅 금지
A named lighting look alone, without positively declared source, placement and receiving-surface relations, does not establish a complete illumination setup.
includes: A coherent illumination setup combining source, spatial placement and receiving surfaces.

location.description: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.
location.description_ko: 장면이 놓인 장소와 공간 구조: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
excludes: 공간의 사용·손상 상태는 space_condition; 대기 중 사건과 장소 자체를 구별
includes: Physical place and structural setting of the scene, distinct from use state or world rules.

medium.description: Physical photographic acquisition or display medium and the image-bearing substrate.
medium.description_ko: 사진의 물리 매체와 이미지 지지체: 여행·패션은 genre; 셀피·CCTV는 촬영 구성; 플랫폼 용도와 분리
excludes: 여행·패션은 genre; 셀피·CCTV는 촬영 구성; 플랫폼 용도와 분리
includes: Physical photographic acquisition or display medium and the image-bearing substrate.

mood.description: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.
mood.description_ko: 장면이 제안하는 정서와 분위기 해석: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
excludes: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
includes: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.

motion_rendering.description: Image-plane freezing, streaks or blur from declared motion and capture, separate from physical action itself.
motion_rendering.description_ko: 영상에 기록된 움직임: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Image-plane freezing, streaks or blur from declared motion and capture, separate from physical action itself.

narrative_clue.description: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.
narrative_clue.description_ko: 서사 해석의 단서: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.

includes: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.

narrative_core.description: Central event, problem or relationship organizing the scene, distinct from a world system or a title alone.
narrative_core.description_ko: 장면을 조직하는 중심 사건·관계·문제: secret garden 같은 제목과 world 전체 체계가 섞임; 단일 사건의 의미 근거 필요
excludes: secret garden 같은 제목과 world 전체 체계가 섞임; 단일 사건의 의미 근거 필요
includes: Central event, problem or relationship organizing the scene, distinct from a world system or a title alone.

narrative_phase.description: Selected instant or phase within an explicitly declared human, natural, mechanical or other event, distinct from clock time, a named occasion and inferred chronology.
narrative_phase.description_ko: 명시된 인간·자연·기계 등 사건 안에서 선택한 순간이나 단계. 하루 시각·행사 명목과 구별하며 사건의 원인·완료·연속 경과를 추론하지 않는다.

An inferred preceding cause, unmentioned event, completed outcome or elapsed sequence.

Human participation is not required. Existing source conditions and actual event/carrier identity remain mandatory.
A procedure operation or material transformation can additionally have its own role; a selected event phase alone does not supply the operation or transformation.

object_structure.description: Visible non-anatomical geometry, bounded parts and structural connections owned by one declared physical object or fixture, independent of its scene role, frame placement and current use state.
object_structure.description_ko: 선언된 물리적 물체·설비 자체의 비해부학적 형상, 경계가 있는 부품과 구조적 연결. 장면에서 맡는 용도·프레임 배치·현재 사용 상태와 구별하며, 몸·의복 특화 구조의 소유 범위를 보존한다.

Frame arrangement, camera viewpoint, relative prop placement or image acuity alone.
Current open/closed, use, damage or readiness state without a separately evidenced structural feature.
Material identity or repeated surface microstructure alone; abstract two-dimensional graphic-path geometry alone.

A named strap assembly with a bar and incoming/returning strap path; a generic attached textile panel with its own bounded edge.
An identified fixture part and its structural joint; no claim of hidden manufacture or performance.

participant_role.description: Explicit participation or relational role of a declared participant, whether primary or secondary, without inferring identity, occupation or a new counterpart from appearance.

excludes: Off-frame placement, a back view and person count belong to their independently supported framing/count roles.
A rival/partner label does not itself create another participant or establish actual identity, occupation, disposition or a performed interaction.
Role truth and tag fit remain separate from effect permission; a prerequisite role cannot authorize a new role or relationship.
includes: A declared participant role can belong to either the primary or another existing participant. The source must identify the actual role carrier and any independently required relation endpoints.

physical_motion.description: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.
physical_motion.description_ko: 물리 움직임 상태와 촬영된 움직임 표현: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
excludes: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
includes: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.

platform_framing.description: Crop-safe and interface-safe placement for a declared output platform, separate from aspect ratio.
platform_framing.description_ko: 출력 매체의 크롭과 UI 안전 영역: 비율은 format; 일반 프레임 가장자리 크롭은 composition·subject_framing
excludes: 비율은 format; 일반 프레임 가장자리 크롭은 composition·subject_framing
includes: Crop-safe and interface-safe placement for a declared output platform, separate from aspect ratio.

procedure_step.description: One identified step in a declared procedure, not a claim that a sequence was observed in one still image.
procedure_step.description_ko: 명시된 작업 과정에서 선택한 단계: 여러 단계의 완료·시간 흐름을 한 픽셀 사실로 취급하지 않음

includes: One identified step in a declared procedure, not a claim that a sequence was observed in one still image.

prop.description: An explicitly owned scene object serving a declared role; placement and state are separate properties.
prop.description_ko: 장면 안에서 특정 역할을 갖는 물건: 주체·착용물·기록 장치와 소유 범위 구별; 빈 dimensions를 자동 통과로 바꾸지 않음
excludes: 주체·착용물·기록 장치와 소유 범위 구별; 빈 dimensions를 자동 통과로 바꾸지 않음
includes: An explicitly owned scene object serving a declared role; placement and state are separate properties.

prop_state.description: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.
prop_state.description_ko: 물건의 사용·정리·고정·손상 상태: 업무 소품으로만 한정할 근거가 약함; duty는 맥락 조건으로 보존

includes: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.

proxemics.description: Physical spacing and access barriers between declared participants, without automatically inferring intimacy or intent.
proxemics.description_ko: 참여자 간 간격과 접근·차단 배치: 거리로 감정·관계를 자동 추론하지 않음; distance_narrative의 물리 요소 이관 검토

publication_caption_context.description: Context of an external publication caption and how it frames interpretation, not text inside the image.
publication_caption_context.description_ko: 게시 문구와 사진 해석의 맥락: 이미지 안의 글자와 분리; 현재 성인 SNS·외모 평가 문구 편향
excludes: 이미지 안의 글자와 분리; 현재 성인 SNS·외모 평가 문구 편향
includes: Context of an external publication caption and how it frames interpretation, not text inside the image.

relational_action.description: Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
relational_action.description_ko: 명시된 행위 주체와 상대·물체 사이의 구체적 상호 동작. 인간·동물·기계·묘사된 대상을 포함하며 실제 행위와 소유·접촉 관계를 구별한다.
excludes: A role label, co-presence, proximity or an isolated hand pose does not supply a performed interaction.
Do not add a counterpart, helper, contact, tool or action endpoint from a verb category alone.
Do not split one actual self-owned body into two people or merge explicitly distinct participants.

Self-directed interaction can address an explicitly owned part or object while retaining its actual part/whole relationship.
A human participant is not compulsory. Intrinsic source conditions, distinctness or part ownership, and actual performed action remain mandatory.

scale_relation.description: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.
scale_relation.description_ko: 둘 이상의 명시된 대상 간 크기 관계: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
excludes: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
includes: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.

shot_scale.description: Extent of subject coverage relative to the photograph's field, without equating it to focal length or physical distance.
shot_scale.description_ko: 대상 대비 촬영 범위의 규모: 포함해야 할 부위의 목적은 subject_framing; 렌즈·거리를 범위만으로 확정하지 않음

includes: Extent of subject coverage relative to the photograph's field, without equating it to focal length or physical distance.
